description: Checks rows from your spreadsheet before importing them as your own products (sold to Printlooper sellers): which rows have problems, how many products and variants it makes, and whether your plan has room. Changes nothing. Rows from the shop spreadsheet, one per product or variant. Each needs title, wholesale_price (your price to sellers) and photo_url (a public https image). Rows with the same title become variants of one product (give variant_title and optional variant_sku and variant_price). Optional: description, tags, storefront_price, material_label, care_instructions and warnings (at least 40 characters each, printed on the card in the box). Needs a connected Printlooper account.
name: preview_catalog_import
title: Check a product import
